items.title: Gore-Gore the ManTaur
items.summary: This fight sequence depicts the confrontation between the Princess Posse (Carl, Katie and Princess Donut) and Gore-Gore the ManTaur (half man, half... other man) in book 3 of the Dungeon Crawler Carl series, written by Matt Dinniman.

items.title: Vengeance of the Daughter
items.summary: This is the final confrontation between Tsarina Signet and Queen Imogen at the Butcher's Masquerade, as written by Matt Dinniman in the book series Dungeon Crawler Carl
